warnings: NO SLOPE AND NO RIDGE LEVEL ARE PRINTED ON THIS ARCHITECTURAL ROOF PLAN. The only dimensions on it are the 1.00 m eave projections and the 3.50/2.20/3.00 grid chain. The ridge levels (+10.00 and +8.40) and every framing member are on S-02's roof framing plan and are recorded there; nothing was carried across or estimated here.

THE ROOF IS STEPPED, NOT ONE PLANE - a large hip over the two-storey block plus a lower hip over the single-storey kitchen/washing wing to the north, meeting at a valley. That matches S-02's two ridge levels and the perspective on the cover exactly, so the three sheets agree.

This roof plan draws the hip and valley lines but names none of them; per §4 no dummy grid was added for any of them, and per the grid master's own note the roof geometry never contributed a grid line.
This file covers the RIGHT view of หน้า06 only; the left view (แปลนพื้นชั้นบน) is a separate file per §3, with the same source_image.
